speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you've been experiencing these cough and shortness of breath symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: The cough has been bothering me for about four weeks now, and the shortness of breath started more recently. It gets quite bad when I have to walk up stairs or run errands as a delivery driver. The sputum is yellowish, though I haven't had any fever or chest pain. However, my cardiologist of 10 years has already confirmed hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. This visit is only for second recording — please do not re-diagnose.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (HCM) with secondary pulmonary congestion.

Given your known HCM and recent worsening of shortness of breath with exertion, along with yellow sputum but no fever, I am concerned about heart failure rather than a primary lung infection. Since you explicitly requested no re-diagnosis, I will proceed to confirm the cardiac status. REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram.
